/-- Counts of the coordinate-8 upper face, with their original context IDs. -/
theorem upper_counts :
    domains.map (fun row => (row.1, (row.2.filter (fun v => v.testBit 8)).length)) =
      [(22, 13), (23, 13), (24, 13), (25, 13), (26, 13), (27, 13), (28, 14), (29, 14), (64, 13), (65, 13), (66, 13), (67, 13), (68, 13), (69, 13), (70, 14), (71, 14), (106, 13), (107, 13), (108, 13), (109, 13), (110, 13), (111, 13), (112, 14), (113, 14)] := by
  decide

/-- Each selected prepared domain has fewer than 44 upper-face vertices. -/
theorem upper_count_lt_44 :
    ∀ row ∈ domains, (row.2.filter (fun v => v.testBit 8)).length < 44 := by
  decide

#print axioms upper_counts
#print axioms upper_count_lt_44
end FaceCounts226
